不肖多时，随着负责任的身影消失在门口，很快，又是一连串急促的脚步声。
紧随其后，是一中年男人急匆匆出现在林玄的面前，他的脸上还带着惊喜的神色，却在看清楚林玄的一瞬间，扭曲成了不可置信和震惊。
碧空从未想过，自己期待了那么久的前辈，居然会是如此年轻的存在！
？这一次，林玄没有刻意遮掩自己的气息，属于圣境的气息不经意间流露，直接将碧空骇得当场立住。
可是，可是……从那本剑经内的内容来看，所刻录此经的，绝对是一个剑道上的老怪物。
因为，其中所不经意之间流露出来的剑道造诣，太可怕了。
哪怕是没有后面的，只看前面的非禁制内容，碧空都觉得自己受益匪浅。
那怎么也不像是一个年轻人能够写的出来的东西啊。
深深震动之后，碧空的心里，又弥漫起了难以抑制的欣喜。
若是自己能够说动这样的人……只是想一想那个可能性，碧空都无法按捺住自己汹涌澎湃的心潮。
他深深呼吸一口气，整理了一下自己的衣袍，向前一步，便准备开口介绍自己，以及展示自己的诚意。
但谁也没有想到的是，偏偏就在这个时候，众人的耳边，忽然响起来一声爆喝。
当即，负责人的脸色就变了，毫不犹豫捏起手势，想要勾连拍卖行存在的大阵，迅速劫杀搅局之人。
却在手势刚起的时候，猛然瞪大眼睛。
“不对……大阵，怎么消失了？！”
碧空死死睁大了眼睛，突如其来的状况打了他一个措手不及，好在，多年来的经验让他快速冷静了下来，只是咬紧牙关。
“我们所在的这一层楼，只怕是都被封锁了。”

而且，那道声音，碧空实在是太熟悉了！
尤其是空间忽然荡漾起水波纹，两道身影倏忽出现在碧空面前时，就更加让他确定了心中猜测。
那其中一人，被叫到名字，布满剑痕宛如蜈蚣的一张黝黑脸庞上，挤出来一个残忍的笑容，充满了畅快和阴狠。
他死死盯着碧空，瞧见碧空那阴沉沉的脸色时，更是仿佛大仇得报似的大笑起来。
“碧空啊碧空，总算是让我找到你落单的时候了。”
“你这藏头露尾，罪该万死的老狗，杀我女儿之前，可有想过今日？”
“今日，我布下森罗阵法，无论是那位城主还是楼主皆不在你身侧，受死吧！

Da Chao (Da Chao (page 22)) "Yes, senior."
He was attentive and thoughtful, and led Lin Xuan into the VIP lounge to take a seat before he hurriedly turned around.
After a while, the responsible figure disappeared from the door, and soon there was another series of rapid footsteps.
Immediately afterwards, a middle-aged man hurriedly appeared in front of Lin Xuan. His face still had a look of surprise, but the moment he saw Lin Xuan clearly, it turned into disbelief and shock.
Bi Kong never thought that the senior he had been waiting for for so long would actually be such a young person!
? This time, Lin Xuan did not cover up his aura deliberately, and the aura belonging to the holy realm was revealed inadvertently, directly frightening Bi Kong to stand on the spot.
But, but... Judging from the contents of the Sword Scripture, the person who inscribed it was definitely an old monster in the art of swordsmanship.
Because the swordsmanship revealed inadvertently is too terrifying.
Even if there is no following and only the non-restricted content in the front, Bi Kong feels that he has benefited a lot.
That doesn't look like something a young man could write.
After being deeply shocked, Bi Kong's heart was filled with uncontrollable joy.
If he could persuade such a person... just thinking about that possibility, Bi Kong couldn't hold back his surging heart.
He took a deep breath, adjusted his robes, and took a step forward, ready to introduce himself and show his sincerity.
But what no one expected was that at this moment, a loud shout suddenly sounded in everyone's ears.
Immediately, the face of the person in charge changed, and he made hand gestures without hesitation, trying to connect with the large formation of the auction house and quickly rob and kill the person who disrupted the situation.
But when he started to gesture, his eyes suddenly widened.
"No...why did the formation disappear?!"
Bi Kong's eyes widened, and the sudden situation caught him off guard. Fortunately, his years of experience allowed him to calm down quickly, and he just gritted his teeth.
"The floor we are on is probably blocked."
The sealing formation, which confines everything, can surpass the formation set up on the 12th floor of the building. In other words, the grade of this sealing formation is definitely quite high.
Moreover, that voice was so familiar to Bi Kong!
Especially when water ripples suddenly appeared in the space and two figures suddenly appeared in front of the blue sky, it made him even more sure of his guess.
When one of them was called by name, a cruel smile appeared on his dark face covered with sword marks like a centipede, full of joy and viciousness.
He stared at Bi Kong, and when he saw Bi Kong's gloomy expression, he laughed as if he had been avenged.
"Bikong, Bikong, it's finally time for me to find you alone."
"You hide your head and show your tail, you old dog who deserves death, did you think about today before you killed my daughter?"
"Today, I have set up the Senluo Formation. Neither the city lord nor the building owner is by your side. You must die!"
